commit.message:
docs: refresh README with verified capabilities, examples, and API reference

- Rewrote Key Capabilities with SEO-relevant, naturally varied phrasing,
  every fact and identifier verified against current source.
- Added a module-grouped API Reference table mirroring the real,
  current public type index, plus curated member detail for the
  most-used entry points.
- Restored a Project Structure section and reconciled the badge row
  against the real, current package/license metadata.
- Verified every code example's imports and named API members against
  the currently published package; verified format-support claims
  against the library's real formats data with independent source
  corroboration.

Verification: every claim checked against the library's real, current
source (not the prior README's own text); the At-a-Glance diagram, Key
Capabilities, and API Reference table were independently verified for
accuracy and internal consistency before this refresh.

Co-authored-by: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
